-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Discord OAuth credentials and API connectivity.

list-guilds.name: list-guilds
list-guilds.description: List guilds (servers) the bot/user is a member of. Supports pagination.

params.before: Get guilds before this guild ID (for pagination)
params.after: Get guilds after this guild ID (for pagination)
params.withCounts: Include approximate member and presence counts. Default: false

get-guild.name: get-guild
get-guild.description: Get detailed information about a specific guild (server) by ID.

params.withCounts: Include approximate member and presence counts. Default: false

list-channels.name: list-channels
list-channels.description: List channels in a guild. Returns text, voice, category, and other channel types.

get-channel.name: get-channel
get-channel.description: Get detailed information about a specific channel by ID.

create-channel.name: create-channel
create-channel.description: Create a new channel in a guild. Supports text, voice, category, announcement, and forum channels.

params.name: Channel name (1-100 characters)
params.topic: Channel topic/description (max 1024 chars for text, 4096 for forum)
params.nsfw: Mark channel as NSFW. Default: false
params.bitrate: Voice channel bitrate in bits (8000-96000/128000 for boosted guilds)
params.userLimit: Voice channel user limit (0-99, 0 = unlimited). Default: 0

delete-channel.name: delete-channel
delete-channel.description: Delete a channel or close a DM. Requires Manage Channels permission for guild channels.

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Send a message to a Discord channel. Supports text, embeds, mentions, and replies.

params.channelId: Channel ID (snowflake) to send the message to
params.content: Message text content (max 2000 characters, 4000 for nitro)
params.embeds: Optional JSON string of embed objects array. Use buildEmbed helper or pass raw JSON.
params.replyToMessageId: Optional message ID to reply to

list-messages.name: list-messages
list-messages.description: List messages in a channel. Supports pagination via before/after/around message IDs.

params.limit: Number of messages to retrieve (1-100). Default: 50
params.before: Get messages before this message ID
params.after: Get messages after this message ID
params.around: Get messages around this message ID

delete-message.name: delete-message
delete-message.description: Delete a message from a channel. Requires Manage Messages permission if not the message author.

add-reaction.name: add-reaction
add-reaction.description: Add a reaction (emoji) to a message. Use Unicode emoji or custom emoji format name:id.

params.emoji: Emoji to react with. Unicode emoji (e.g. 👍) or custom emoji name:id format

list-members.name: list-members
list-members.description: List members of a guild. Supports pagination via limit and after user ID.

params.after: Get members after this user ID (snowflake) for pagination

get-member.name: get-member
get-member.description: Get a specific guild member by user ID.

list-roles.name: list-roles
list-roles.description: List all roles in a guild, ordered by position (highest first).

create-role.name: create-role
create-role.description: Create a new role in a guild. Requires Manage Roles permission.

params.name: Role name (max 100 characters)
params.color: Role color as integer (0 = no color). Use RGB integer value.
params.hoist: Display role members separately in online list. Default: false
params.unicodeEmoji: Unicode emoji to use as role icon
params.mentionable: Allow anyone to @mention this role. Default: false

assign-role.name: assign-role
assign-role.description: Add a role to a guild member. Requires Manage Roles permission with the bot's role above the target role.

params.userId: User ID (snowflake) to assign the role to

remove-role.name: remove-role
remove-role.description: Remove a role from a guild member. Requires Manage Roles permission.

params.userId: User ID (snowflake) to remove the role from

list-webhooks.name: list-webhooks
list-webhooks.description: List webhooks in a guild or channel. Requires Manage Webhooks permission.

params.guildId: Guild ID (snowflake) to list all webhooks in the guild
params.channelId: Channel ID (snowflake) to list webhooks in a specific channel

create-webhook.name: create-webhook
create-webhook.description: Create a new webhook in a channel. Requires Manage Webhooks permission. Returns the webhook token for sending messages.

params.channelId: Channel ID (snowflake) to create the webhook in
params.name: Webhook name (1-80 characters, cannot contain 'clyde' or 'discord')

send-webhook-message.name: send-webhook-message
send-webhook-message.description: Send a message via a webhook using the webhook URL. Supports text, embeds, and usernames.

params.avatarUrl: Override the webhook's default avatar URL
params.embeds: Optional JSON string of embed objects array
params.threadId: Optional thread ID to send the message in a forum thread

kick-member.name: kick-member
kick-member.description: Kick a member from a guild. Requires Kick Members permission.

params.userId: User ID (snowflake) of the member to kick
params.reason: Optional audit log reason for the kick

ban-member.name: ban-member
ban-member.description: Ban a member from a guild. Optionally delete their message history. Requires Ban Members permission.

params.userId: User ID (snowflake) of the member to ban
params.deleteMessageSeconds: Number of seconds to delete messages for (0-604800, 7 days max). Default: 0
params.reason: Optional audit log reason for the ban

timeout-member.name: timeout-member
timeout-member.description: Timeout (mute) a guild member for a specified duration. Requires Moderate Members permission.

params.userId: User ID (snowflake) of the member to timeout
params.durationMinutes: Timeout duration in minutes (max 40320 = 28 days). Default: 60

name: Discord
description: Full Discord integration: guilds, channels, messages, members, roles, webhooks, threads, reactions, and moderation. Uses Discord REST API with OAuth 2.0 / Bot Token.

changelog.notes: Initial release — send and read messages, manage servers, channels, roles, members and webhooks, react, and moderate
